preconditions.description: The number of workers n is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.
The numerator a and denominator b of the parameter k are between 1 and 100000 inclusive, and a is less than or equal to b.
The length of the string s is equal to the number of workers n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists of lowercase English characters only.

preconditions.expression: all(c not in 'trygb' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s does not contain the characters 't', 'r', 'y', 'g', 'u', or 'b'.

postconditions.description: The output c is a non-negative integer representing the number of obtainable job categories.
The output obtainable_categories is a list of length c containing the obtainable job categories.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cat, str) and len(cat) == 1 for cat in obtainable_categories)
postconditions.description: Each element in the obtainable_categories list is a single lowercase English character.

postconditions.expression: all(cat in s for cat in obtainable_categories)
postconditions.description: Each obtainable job category is present in the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(all(k * (i_m - i_1 + 1) <= m for i_1, i_m, m in get_segments(s, cat)) for cat in obtainable_categories)
postconditions.description: For each obtainable job category, all segments of workers with that category satisfy the condition k * (i_m - i_1 + 1) <= m.
The obtainable job categories are sorted in lexicographical order.
